scope: Supplementary theoretical checks, not a replacement or retuning of the frozen R15 learning experiment
corner_range: Audit all 128 vertices of the fixed six-reward-plus-friction context box. Convexity of the optimal value in this affine context makes the maximum dual upper bound a valid deterministic population range. It is not a deployment-sample maximum. Report both the original analytical range and this additional range, including its offline cost.
inference: Keep the original eight-pair Student interval as primary. Use 56 frozen policies and 256 independent contexts each for conditional simultaneous Hoeffding bounds. Separately use only eight independent training/deployment means, not 2048 falsely independent fits, for unconditional bounds over the seven fixed procedures. Report zero whenever the bound is vacuous. The sign test is secondary, not originally prespecified.
nonquadratic_check: Sixteen contexts, seeds 16001 for the 15-node/two-service/three-resource primitive, 16002 for contexts, and 16003 for price perturbations. Add sum(v^4/4) to quadratic resource coupling. Independently certify feasible policies and conjugate upper bounds by rational arithmetic. Check the global inexact-response theorem and two exact scalar sharpness identities. No claim of nonlinear trained-policy results is attached to these structural checks.
ordering: Execute after the primary timing study so this supplementary numerical workload does not contend with its timed solves. Preserve every result and failure.
